name: sparrow
description: Sparrow — a friendly little AI helper at the top of your screen.
author: Muhammad Talha

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare-web && electron-builder --mac dir --universal --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sparrow listens when you say “Sparrow…” or tap the mic.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sparrow turns what you say into text so it can help you.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Sparrow controls apps you ask it to, like Spotify, Music and Mail.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: Sparrow uses your location to tell you the weather and prayer times where you are.
extendInfo.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sparrow uses your location to tell you the weather and prayer times where you are.
